yfsqxtex.sourceDescription: This artificial Christmas tree is sure to become a magical eye-catcher among your Christmas decorations and create a unique Christmas atmosphere! This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. 97w21xts.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
97w21xts.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree serves as a perfect addition to your festive decor, whether placed in the living room or as part of your garden festivities. Its simple, cone-shaped design offers a contemporary twist, combining minimal ornamentation with a functional approach that complements any modern interior. The adaptable nature of this tree makes it an ideal fit for both small apartments and expansive holiday settings, providing a centerpiece that captivates without overwhelming the surrounding space. High-Quality Materials Crafted from durable PVC, this tree boasts longevity and resilience, allowing it to withstand the wear of seasonal setup and storage. The PVC material gives the tree a realistic density, closely mimicking the appearance of natural fir while offering flame-resistant properties for added safety. This ensures that your decor remains both attractive and secure throughout the festive season. Effortless Lighting Equipped with LED strip lights boasting a warm white hue, the tree illuminates your space with a comforting glow. The flexible nature of these lights allows you to position them precisely, enhancing the aesthetic without the frustration of tangled wires. Designed for energy efficiency, these LEDs contribute to an economical holiday display that can brighten any room or garden. User-Friendly Assembly The tree features hinged branches that allow for straightforward assembly, requiring no additional tools besides a screwdriver for the initial setup.
